column3: The Hebrew names the gods as worthless things; BSB says idols.
The Hebrew has strength and beauty in the sanctuary without the explicit fill added by BSB.
The Hebrew says the glory of His name without the explicit due in BSB.
The Hebrew names His face and splendor of holiness without the His BSB supplies before holiness.
The Hebrew has field in the singular; BSB has fields.
The Hebrew repeats for He comes including the conjunction; BSB repeats He is coming without the second for.
